title: How Finely Can Vision-Language Models See Biology? Bio-VQA: A Benchmark for Taxonomic, Morphological, Spatial and Individual Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05559v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In biodiversity monitoring, a single image raises several questions: which taxon, how many, which trait, and whether the individual has been seen before. Vision-language models (VLMs) could answer all of these from the image, but their ability is largely untested in biology, as existing benchmarks focus mostly on species identification within a few taxonomic groups. We present Bio-VQA, the largest biological visual question answering (VQA) benchmark and the only one to span four aspects of biological visual understanding: hierarchical taxonomic reasoning, fine-grained attribute grounding, quantitative spatial reasoning, and individual re-identification. Bio-VQA contains 1.86M questions over 217K images from 11 public datasets, and extends right-or-wrong scoring to graded scoring, so a near-miss counts for more than a distant one. translated_title: 视觉-语言模型能把生物学看得多细致？Bio-VQA：一个面向分类学、形态学、空间和个体推理的基准测试
translated_abstract: 在生物多样性监测中，一张图像会引出多个问题：它属于哪个分类单元、数量是多少、具有什么形态特征、以及该个体此前是否被观测过。视觉-语言模型（VLMs）本可以从图像中回答所有这些问题，但其在生物学领域的能力在很大程度上尚未经过检验，因为现有的基准测试大多只局限于少数分类群内的物种识别。我们提出了Bio-VQA，这是目前最大的生物视觉问答（VQA）基准，也是唯一一个涵盖生物视觉理解四个方面的基准：层次化分类推理、细粒度属性定位、定量空间推理和个体重识别。Bio-VQA包含来自11个公开数据集的21.7万张图像上的186万个问题，并将简单的对错评分扩展为分级评分，使得接近正确的答案比偏差较大的答案获得更高的分数。通过对18个参数量从3.75B到38.4B的开源权重模型进行评估，我们发现通用视觉能力（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了Bio-VQA——目前最大的生物视觉问答基准，涵盖层次化分类推理、细粒度属性定位、定量空间推理和个体重识别四个方面，包含21.7万张图像上的186万个问题，并引入分级评分机制，系统评估了18个开源视觉-语言模型在生物理解上的能力。
en_tdlr: We present Bio-VQA, the largest biological VQA benchmark spanning hierarchical taxonomic reasoning, fine-grained attribute grounding, quantitative spatial reasoning, and individual re-identification, with 1.86M questions over 217K images and a new graded scoring scheme, revealing how well (or poorly) open-weight vision-language models understand biology.
